sentence: This project builds a toolkit that checks that programs running many tasks at once inside an operating system kernel work correctly.
This project helps mathematicians use artificial intelligence and automated reasoning tools in their mathematics research.
This project builds a faster way to measure uncertainty in very large data sets whose values depend on each other.
This project studies what encourages and what hinders faculty at a two-year college in creating research experiences in science and mathematics programs.
This project builds a testbed that links equipment at several campuses over the Internet to imitate a real electric power grid and test its safety.
This project uses historic and modern animal samples from museums to study how pox viruses evolved and which animals they can infect.
This project studies how attackers can interfere with self-driving car software and vehicle controls, and looks for ways to defend against them.
This project builds a remote platform that gives learners online access to physical boards for hardware security experiments.
This project develops a computer chip that does artificial intelligence calculations with light instead of electricity.
This project works on the final steps of building a cyclotron that will make neutrinos for physics measurements underground.
This project holds a workshop where scientists compare how small electrical pulses sent into the brain affect mice, monkeys and people.
This project studies how sound waves move through materials under extreme conditions, such as iron alloys and silicates found in planetary cores.
